defect_observations.detail: Annex file begins directly with an annexitem; unlike sibling P15 annex files it has no section heading or sec:annex-p15-regular-conditional-laws label. Not a coverage gap.

The uniform-square null-event example Z=Y/(1+X) is not on Durrett pp. 210, 214-216 as opened (only Borel's paradox, Example 4.1.8, is there). The text does not attribute this example to Durrett explicitly, but the chapter opening (lines 6-8) names Durrett as the source. A reviewer may want the example marked as supplied by the handbook.

Durrett's Thm 2.1.22 sketch (p. 54) declares phi_o composed with psi the coding without an image or inverse argument ('Caveat emptor'). The handbook adds H = closure of S and an explicit Borel image and inverse, and defines standard Borel as coding onto a Borel subset, which is stronger than the source's 'nice' wording (1-1 map into R, both directions measurable). The variant is stated explicitly at lines 174-180; reviewers should confirm the stronger definition is intended.
